en.title: Score Correction and Audit Trail Procedures
en.excerpt: How scorekeepers and tournament directors edit incorrectly entered arrow values before and after ends are submitted.

toc.text: Correcting Arrow Values in Active Ends

en.content:
Correcting Arrow Values in Active Ends

While an end is still open on the mobile keypad, tap any incorrect arrow cell (e.g., changing an 8 to a 9) to overwrite the value before tapping Submit End.

Editing Previously Submitted Ends

If an error is discovered after submitting an end (e.g., during physical paper score sheet reconciliation):

  1. The scorekeeper or judge taps the End Selector Tab at the top of the scoring screen.
  2. Select the specific End number to unlock its score cells.
  3. Adjust the arrow values and tap Update End Scores.

Audit Logging & Referee Confirmation

All score edits trigger an instant recalculation of total hits, 10s, and Xs. The live public leaderboard updates in real-time, maintaining an uncorrupted audit history for tournament directors.
